events.title: Portuguese navigator João da Nova sights St Helena
events.description: Returning from India, João da Nova's fleet found an uninhabited island in the South Atlantic, traditionally on St Helena's feast day. It became a vital supply stop and later Napoleon's place of exile.

events.title: John Sobieski is elected King of Poland
events.description: The nobility of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth elected the victorious commander Jan Sobieski as John III. In 1683 he led the relief army that broke the Ottoman siege of Vienna.
events.html: The nobility of the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth elected the victorious commander Jan Sobieski as John III. In 1683 he led the relief army that broke the Ottoman siege of Vienna.

events.title: William Hobson proclaims British sovereignty over New Zealand
events.description: Following the Treaty of Waitangi, Lieutenant-Governor Hobson declared British sovereignty over the North Island by cession and the South Island by discovery. The treaty's meaning is still central to New Zealand law.
events.html: Following the Treaty of Waitangi, Lieutenant-Governor Hobson declared British sovereignty over the North Island by cession and the South Island by discovery. The treaty's meaning is still central to New Zealand law.

events.title: Clara Barton founds the American Red Cross
events.description: Clara Barton, a nurse in the Civil War, set up the American Association of the Red Cross in Washington. It became the country's main organisation for disaster relief and blood donation.

events.title: Lindbergh lands in Paris after flying the Atlantic alone
events.description: Charles Lindbergh touched down at Le Bourget after 33.5 hours in the air, greeted by a crowd of some 100,000. He won the $25,000 Orteig Prize and instant worldwide fame.
events.html: Charles Lindbergh touched down at Le Bourget after 33.5 hours in the air, greeted by a crowd of some 100,000. He won the $25,000 Orteig Prize and instant worldwide fame.

events.title: Rajiv Gandhi is assassinated in Tamil Nadu
events.description: A suicide bomber from the Tamil Tigers killed the former Indian prime minister at an election rally in Sriperumbudur. His mother, Indira Gandhi, had been assassinated in 1984.
